name: moducpp-language-tools
description: Language Server Protocol diagnostics for ModuCPP scripts.

moducpp.diagnostics.command.description: Optional command run by the language server to produce ModuCPP transpiler/C++ compiler diagnostics. Use ${file} and ${workspaceFolder} placeholders.

moducpp.diagnostics.enableEditorChecks.description: Enable a small set of high-confidence editor-only ModuCPP surface syntax checks. The engine/compiler diagnostics command remains the source of truth.
